(3 items) Adds 3-129 Weapon and Spell Damage

(5 items) Consuming a corpse causes the corpse to explode, dealing |cffffff1298|r Disease Damage to enemies within 5 meters and applying the Diseased status effect and Minor Breach to them for |cffffff5|r seconds, reducing their Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff2974|r. This effect can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds, scales off the higher of your Weapon or Spell Damage, and deals |cffffff10|r% more damage for each Grave Lord ability slotted.
